name: node-agent-timer
description: The timer node: wake a node later by calling chat_no_wait on it - set / cancel / list, plus its own page

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs

node.desc: Timers: what is pending, how long is left, repeats, and a form to add one

mode.description: alarm: a moment on the clock, with `at`. countdown: a length of time from now, with `after_seconds`. Leave it out and the argument you gave decides

after_seconds.description: countdown mode: seconds from now; fractions allowed (300 = in five minutes)

at.description: alarm mode: a clock time "HH:MM" (tomorrow if it has passed today) or an ISO-8601 timestamp

message.description: the sentence the node is woken with; the timer adds where it came from

repeat.description: an alarm repeats: once (default), daily, weekdays, weekly. A countdown repeats: once, or every:<seconds> (>= 60)

node.description: which node to wake; default is the caller, so a timer wakes me

priority.description: queue waits for the current turn, interpret goes into it; default queue

name.description: a short label for the page, e.g. "the oven"

set.description: Wake a node at a time (mode alarm, at) or after a delay (mode countdown, after_seconds), optionally repeating; returns the id

cancel.description: Cancel one timer, repeats included, so it never fires again

list.description: Every timer: id, target, message, mode, kind, repeat, next_at, in_seconds, phrase

priority.description: queue waits for the current turn, interpret goes into it

message.description: the sentence the node is woken with

mode.description: alarm: a moment on the clock; countdown: a length of time from now

repeat.description: once (default), daily, weekdays, weekly, or every:<seconds>

firesAt.description: when it goes off, as a number

ui.description: Timers: what is pending, how long is left, repeats, and a form to add one
